description: Get preliminary U.S. domestic shipping guidance for one product: the answer with claim-level source IDs, the facts check_product accepts (ids, types, allowed values), carrier context, review dates and the cited official sources. Accepts product slugs, named products and aliases. FAQs, rule evidence and the full source list are left out unless requested with include.

include.description: Optional extras: faqs, rule_evidence (every rule with its condition) or all_sources.

slug.description: A product slug from list_products (laptop, power-bank), a named product (iphone-15, anker-737-power-bank, aerosol-deodorant) or a product name or alias (cbd oil).

name: get_product_guidance
title: Get Product Shipping Guidance
